item.title: 5 Jaw-Dropping Underwater Migrations
item.description: These five mesmerizing clips reveal how honey bees use the waggle dance to share precise directions to nectar-rich blooms. Watch the angle, duration and vigor of each dance—on the honeycomb and in full field footage—to see nature’s most elegant GPS system in action and learn to “read” their buzz-powered choreography. The post 5 Jaw-Dropping Underwater Migrations appeared first on One Green Planet.
